title: The Global T20 Nomad: AD Hales's Journey Across 9 Leagues
summary: AD Hales has played in 9 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL), scoring 8953 runs at 31.6.
body:
## 9 Leagues, One Mission

AD Hales is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **9 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL, LPL, MLC, PSL, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 8953 runs | 311 innings | Avg 31.6 | SR 142.7

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Hales has delivered across all of them.

---
*Data across 9 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
